name: Backend Rust
description: Orchestration profile for Rust backend services requiring memory safety, strict typing, and no implicit panics.

tools.name: cargo
tools.description: Rust Cargo package manager and test runner.

candidate_checks.description: Check compilation and the type system across all targets.
Run all unit and integration tests in the Cargo workspace.
Run static analysis to detect logic defects and anti-patterns in Rust.

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of the accepted cargo check / cargo test commands
Valid file scope verification and git diff --check output
Evidence triage report from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluation from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: Using unwrap() or expect() on production execution paths causing panics
Introducing unsafe blocks without a mandatory justification and invariant proof
Integer overflow or rounding errors in fixed-point calculations
quant_escalation_required_when: Computing PnL, funding rates, liquidation, pricing engines, or risk management
